settings.text: We accept returns within 15 days of the delivery date. To be eligible, items must be unworn, unwashed, and in their original condition with all tags attached and original packaging intact.
The following items cannot be returned: sale or discounted items marked as final sale, innerwear and swimwear, gift cards, and items that have been worn, washed, altered, or damaged after delivery.
Visit our Start a Return page and submit your request with your order number and item details. Our team will confirm eligibility and schedule a pickup within 2 business days.

Once we receive and inspect your return, we will notify you by email. Approved refunds are processed to your original payment method within 5–7 business days. Shipping charges are non-refundable unless the item was defective or incorrectly sent.

We offer exchanges for a different size or colour, subject to availability. Please select 'Exchange' when initiating your return and specify your preferred size or colour. Exchanges ship free of charge.
If your item arrived damaged or defective, please contact us at support@bluer.com within 48 hours of delivery with photos. We will arrange a free return and send a replacement or issue a full refund.

settings.title: Return Policy
settings.intro: We want you to love what you ordered. If something isn't right, we make returns simple.
